```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "data/wildfires.geojson",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
# Extract the first fire
fire <- raw$features[[1]]

# Show its component names
names(fire)

# Extract the first coordinate pair of its boundary
fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```


```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(
    geometry,
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  select(
    incident,
    gis_acres,
    fire_year,
    agency,
    state,
    geometry_coordinates
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(!is.na(state)) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(total_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(state, total_acres), y = total_acres)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 States by Acres Burned",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "States are ranked by the sum of reported GIS acres."
  )
```


```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(
      map(
        geometry_coordinates,
        \(rings) sf::st_polygon(
          map(rings, \(ring) do.call(rbind, map(ring, unlist)))
        )
      ),
      crs = 4326
    )
  ) |>
  sf::st_as_sf()

```


```{r}
bounds <- sf::st_bbox(big_fires)

leaflet(big_fires) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  fitBounds(
    bounds["xmin"],
    bounds["ymin"],
    bounds["xmax"],
    bounds["ymax"]
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", format(round(gis_acres), big.mark = ",")
    )
  )
```
